title: The James Webb Telescope Is Changing Astronomers’ Understanding of the Ancient Cosmos
summary: The story of black holes has become more complicated thanks to JWST, which keeps spotting ancient black holes that are too big to explain with established theories—much too big. Or perhaps supermassive black holes never started as stars at all.
